notes: R400 000 determined value, maintenance plan included in the purchase price: 3.25% = R13 000 a month (G21 p. 5). Employer satisfied that business use is at least 80%: only 20% of the benefit is remuneration for PAYE = R2 600 (BRS code 4582 p. 105). Taxable remuneration 42 600; x12 = 511 200; tax = 79 998 + 31% x (511 200 - 383 100) = 119 709; less 17 820 = 101 889; /12 = 8490.75. The calculator taxes the full R13 000. Same named limit as fb-vehicle-3802-35pct-80pct-taxed (80/20 on the vehicle benefit is the BRS 4582 wording, not a G21 sentence).
